title: I just had a dream of a HOTEL to the MALL WORLD
content: **Let me start off by saying this is the craziest and LONGEST dream I ever had EVER in my life. Last night 8/8/23 .** I start off in a hotel, it looks like I just worked a shift or something and was getting ready to go somewhere. I went inside the hotel, and I was in this room at first with another person. We shared a bed which was odd, and I had to leave because I was preparing for the test that we had to take later to pass to get to the MALL WORLD. I then went into another hotel room with a girl and she had the same pumpkin doll I had but with a different facial expression. She was trying to cuddle with me by having one of her hands on my chest as we were trying to sleep the door kept opening and I kept hearing people chattering. Finally, the door swung open and it was like a guy she liked but she felt unconformable around him at times and she had anxiety, so I told her to breathe in and out and take deep breaths. We didn't do anything as she told me she was going to the morning bar to grab something to eat. She left the room so I left the room also and was in this huge lobby with a bunch of people in it. After the lobby insistent I saw the girl again walking with two other girls and then followed by the guy as she told some random people to leave her alone and they exited to another room. Everything then turned black as I was feeling sad and then the next scene I was in another hotel that was connected inside a huge mall. I followed these guys as if I knew them outside the hotel into this huge WORLD that was inside a building. Then I followed this guy that was like my friend but I have never seen him in real life. We had to take this placement test. It was called the aptitude test for reason which would determine your skills and the best fit on where you need to go to work. I kept avoiding the test and wanted to explore around. The first place I visited was this weird open room with a bunch of people that were doing different tests on things. Me and the friend were greeted by one of the officers or owners or someone important that told us where we were and that this place was great. She then pointed to this huge pool and told us if we ever needed to cool off that we could take swim and then she left as she told us to join this little group that were testing objects. This girl I never met but looked familiar to a crush I use to have on this girl in middle school, they looked the same but it wasn't the same person exactly. She asked me, "Do you like it here? Is this place better than the place you lived?" I answered yes I like it here it kind of reminds me of the place I was at but I was so confused when answering this question. They were doing these tests and I couldn't understand what they were doing and didn't get what they were doing. They then took a break and split up and I was trying to find them again. I even asked other groups if they have seen them but nobody would help so I tried joining another group and they told me I don't belong in that group so I left the giant room and started exploring. I then saw a bowling alley room and a pool hall where games were being played and people having fun. I saw this gigantic bathroom and there was one person in it and he was out in the open and we made eye contact, so I quickly looked away. I started exploring more until I came to this strip that had a door that opened to this huge living room with a bunch of doors indicating other rooms. Someone asked me are you lost? I said no I am just seeing everything and what it has to offer they then pointed to this room for me to go in so I did. This person was in it and they welcomed me and said alright stare at this object and blink 3 times as I did I felt like I was being transported and suddenly I was in a different part of the mall with a bunch more rooms and stairs everywhere. I quickly looked around and was trying all these doors but they were locked and some weird person started shouting my name and stated that I needed to take the test but he didn't know who I was so he would repeat this message like every 10 seconds going room to room. It was like I was loose and everyone had a job and you had to have a job to live there. I kept walking which seemed like forever passed and all these people and all these rooms until I was at the area where I was before I was transported so I made it back to that area. I was trying to find the exit room or exit door to return back to the main part of the MALL where I was at the beginning so I can take this test. However the rooms were different this time and I went to the end just to see this weird band performing for nobody. So I left that thinking that was odd and weird nobody watching this band perform so I thought I found the door that put in this place but it wasn't then finally I saw this sliding door which lead me back to the main part however I wasn't at the right location but I could see it from a distance. I started using the escalator but it wouldn't work and I was confused on why it wouldn't work. So then I traveled to this slide, which slid you down this area to where I needed to be. Half way through it I got stuck and I asked the lady does this happen often but she ignored me and put an out of order sign up as she was kind of happy that the whole slide was broken. Finally I found one that worked and I was trying to find the hotel but then it lead me back to the place where it was like a living room with a bunch of rooms. I thought to myself am I going in circles here? What is going on but ONCE AGAIN the rooms and the place was different. Then I notice the right room so I entered it and to my surprise it was totally different. I tried the blinking trick and someone laughed and said that doesn't work here. So I asked how do I transport? She said you have to spin in a full circle 3 times then go down them stairs and it will send you to the place you need to go. So I did that and once again the lights started blinking so I headed downstairs... WOW! Another new room this room was huge with a giant balcony that I was on that had a bunch of random doors around the whole circle. When I met this place was huge, I MEAN HUGE about 4 football stadiums huge so it would take a great while to get around the whole place. I finally just went through one of the doors and I was greeted by these weird people that were hiding. They were claiming that they were finally safe and they had a bunch of notes which is their "money". These notes can buy you stuff or a room and that's what you had to have in order to survive. They ran from what they called the "System". Which was like the cops but they were like guardsmen or something and somehow they knew these people escaped their clutches and were looking for them. So I exited the room to explore more and found myself on the huge balcony again when I saw a bunch of these guards rush in and I thought they were coming after me so I ran. One of them shouted for me to stop and it was weird because they gearing up on these computer panels that surrounded the balcony so I went on one of these panels and out of nowhere two people joined me on each side. They asked me if I knew how to operate these machines, suddenly I was geared up in this mech suit. They told me to try to escape or the guardsmen were going get me and detain me and take me to a dark place where nobody wants to go. So I was flying in this suit and one of them shouted you didn't read the "manual" did you. He was trying to shout out directions on how to use the mech suit, which was a weird mech suit because it only was gloves and hyper boots nothing else but it gave you the ability to shoot weird stringy stuff and these weird weapons that you had to press down a certain way to activate them. I started flying around spraying people and the guards chasing me. Out of nowhere a bomb came into play and I could hear the people say oh he's down now. Somehow I flew passed that and kept on going until I saw a hole so I dived into the hole and was in another part of the mall. This part was weird and it was looking like it was shutting down and everyone was returning to their homes, I remember I tried to follow these women to this place as the walls and staircase were starting to cave in and they told me there wasn't enough room for me to be in there and that I needed to leave so I did. I then saw this girl and she was very nice and asked if I was new to this place, strange enough we made out but then she said she had to go and so I started walking onwards to a strange hall that had all these different shops. I was thinking in my head oh I need to find a job so I can collect these notes so I can survive. I wanted to work with computers and I saw this place filled with computers and people working on computers but it was weird because they had a USB port in their mouth. THE WEIRDEST THING I EVER SAW. I asked questions and they asked me what was my actions per minute and I told them 100. She said this is security and we get a bunch of threats and you have to be top notch to work here so she asked for my papers. I said what papers? She then asked have you taken the test? I replied no I haven't taken the test yet and I was looking for the place to take it, she then said return after you have your papers and you have taken the test. I thought maybe I didn't want this job because they had USB the end of it I might add in their mouths. SO STRANGE enough I said I wonder what that is like and put one in my mouth to see if I really wanted to work there or not and I was like this is weird so I left to find another job. I came across this sports shop and he said he wasn't hiring because the place was very slow and sports were becoming obsolete. I was kind of disappointed on not getting that job because it looked like he was having a blast because his room was a huge living room with a couch and big screen tv with a counter on the front for people to enter but then the hallway was short that didn't really have much to sell but I was upset because it looked like a cool job to have so I continued on my journey and I saw this exit. A weird tunnel that lead you to this weird river. This river had people in it that were traveling by foot to this other place. It was like we were escaping "The System" to another part of the world, I want to say this was an island that had 2 huge MALL WORLDS, one in the north and one in the south. Anyway traveling down this river by holding on to side rail which guided me through it with others we had to climb up for the last part and then we were finally there. It lead me to this elevator that went down into the mall. THIS MALL WAS MUCH DIFFERENT. It wasn't futuristic. It was like an old ROME MALL, like what you would see at ROME. Much different as I enter the front part and it was like a huge center of all these different places. I was blown away by the structure of this place, it looked nice but it looked like it was built in the past, a place I never seen before. I compare it to what ROME would look like in the year 3000 though. This place though was much different, it didn't rely on technology or computers or anything like that. It relied on sports, it was all about sports. So I continue walking through this mall and then I start seeing places that are run down, broken apart and finally I enter this doorway that led me to this gigantic place that these people welcomed me. The place was in horrible shape with all kinds of things broken and didn't look nothing like the mall that I escaped from. These people then led me to somewhere that totally blew my mind, I go through halls that had stuff everywhere, laying everywhere and was very trashy. After going through all that I enter this center room that was between 2 huge stadiums that looked very nice. As look at the first one I see a huge coliseum and a field that looked like a sport was about to be played. The other stadium had a huge dirt like field that had a bunch of other little fields in it that people were in practicing sports that I never seen before. The fields were of sports I was familiar with and sports I never seen before and this weird karate like sport that was people fighting in the mud, but the mud would be like hard to maneuver in so they were struggling to hit each other. I then saw a ring and a basketball court and a football field and a soccer field and all kinds of fields following that, suddenly I was getting really excited and then I woke up. I was so sad that I woke up because I wanted to explore more, of course I left a bunch of details out and I didn't want to include this one part because it didn't really relate to the story but I never had a long dream like that. When I started researching this dream I saw a bunch of similar stories, I really wonder what this was all about. I do have spaceship dreams where I am in a spaceship and everyone has a role inside the spaceship that is a job and we are just floating in space but there are areas to keep us alive and people have to their part to stay alive and keep the spaceship going. I wanted to put this out there, craziest dream I ever had was the one last night. I will add I have been sober for 17 days now and I know without THC you start to experience and remember your dreams but this one was the craziest, longest and it still has me shock DREAMS I ever had, thanks for reading this if you read it all.
